name: Roman Axelrod
current_role: Founder & Managing Partner, XPANCEO (Dubai smart-contact-lens deep-tech company)
profile: Roman Axelrod founded XPANCEO in Dubai with nanophotonics scientist Dr. Valentyn Volkov. The company is building an invisible, weightless smart contact lens as an AI-era computing platform. He has 17+ years building companies across Europe, the US and the Middle East, and at XPANCEO runs strategy, product, marketing and operations. The company raised what it calls MENA's largest Series A.
interesting_fact: XPANCEO says the Nature Index ranks it the world's No. 1 private startup by research output in natural sciences (June 2025-May 2026), and it has applied for 50+ patents.
deep_cut_fact: He holds a master's-level Diploma in Strategy and Finance from Oxford's Saïd Business School and has an academic background in international private law. In 2024 he was named to MIT Technology Review Arabia's Innovators Under 35.
notes: Writes thought-leadership pieces (Fast Company, TechCrunch, Crunchbase News on fundraising and investor trust), so pitching a conversation about deep-tech fundraising may resonate. The newsroom offers a press kit.
